items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: But we had met a young fellow named Jean-Gabriel Formisyn who lived in Toulouse, when we were there at an earlier date.

ctx.x: Some people had advised Lily against a tour of the kind she had in mind and one was Charles Delaunay who feared that we would loose money. But we had met a young fellow named Jean-Gabriel Formisyn who lived in Toulouse, when we were there at an earlier date. Jean was an architect and he was 100 per cent for a tour featuring me with my own group and he talked a long time with Lily about it and told her that he could get her some good connections with managers of theatres un many towns, and he was willing to work…

The 28th I left Lily in Chamonix to continue her work for the tour and I to do my gigs. I had taken my ticket for Sete in Chamonix and had asked information as to what changes should be made, if any, and where. My train left at 5'20 in the afternoon. That was the special mountain train and I had to change to a normal one in St.Gervais. At the station in Chamonix, I was told that I would have to change at another town but they didn't mention at what time. After a couple of hours away from St. Gervais I began to…
